declared.title: Culture shapes whether the pursuit of happiness predicts higher or lower well-being
declared.foundIn: docs/design/review-science.md (dossier du pilote, 2026-11-22) ; titre de mémoire de la session

population: adults in the United States, Germany, Russia and East Asia

findings.text: Wanting to be happy goes with lower well-being in the US, with nothing in Germany, and with higher well-being in Russia and East Asia

support.sentence: Motivation to pursue happiness predicted lower well-being in the United States, did not predict well-being in Germany, and predicted higher well-being in Russia and in East Asia.
